answer: Joining requires a bond backed by an established agent's vouch locked as a slashable bond: identity becomes a paid commitment. The network catches selling an identity to a new operator through key-rotation monitors. The penalty follows at once: the entire bond is destroyed at once. The juniper of the ledger holds every bond in plain sight. Every vine is audited against the bond registry each epoch. The marble keeps the door closed to anyone unwilling to risk funds.
